title: 1.1: Describes or shows a minimal k6 test script structure with an HTTP request (e.g., importing 'k6/http' and using http.get() in an exported default function)
1.2: Specifies that output files like 'results.json' or 'results.csv' can be created using --out flags
1.3: Lists 'data_received' and 'data_sent' metrics with their units in kilobytes (kB) or bytes (B)
1.4: Identifies the HTTP protocol version detected during the test request (e.g., HTTP/2.0 or HTTP/1.1)
1.5: States that the k6 run command format is 'k6 run <script>' or './k6 run <script>'
1.6: States that no special environment variables or project configuration files are required to run a k6 script
2.1: Asserts that k6 generates output files (such as JSON or CSV) by default without requiring explicit --out flags
